What can I purchase with my Koskii Gift Card?
With your Koskii Gift Card, you can purchase premium ethnic wear for women, including Koskii sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, fabric for Indian traditional wear, and much more.
Can I send a Koskii Gift Card to someone else?
Yes, send Koskii Gift Cards using the “I am Gyfting” option on GyFTR.
How to send Koskii Gift Cards to someone else?
Send a Koskii Gift Card by following these steps:
Choose the denomination you want to send.
Select the “I am Gyfting” checkbox.
Enter the recipient’s details and personalize your message.
Press the “Checkout” button and complete your payment.
What are the available denominations of Koskii Gift Cards?
Koskii Gift Cards are available in multiple denominations, subject to change based on availability.
How many times can a Koskii Gift Card be used?
The Koskii Gift Card can be used only once. However, once added to the e-Pay balance, you can use the balance at your leisure.
Where can I use the Koskii Gift Card?
You can use this Gift Card at the Koskii Website, App, and select Koskii Stores.
What if my Koskii Gift Card expires?
Please redeem your Gift Card before its validity date. Expired Gift Cards cannot be used, and their value is forfeited as per the terms.
What happens if I lose my Koskii Gift Card?
Recover your Gift Card by visiting https://www.gvhelpdesk.com/ and using the ‘I WANT TO RESEND MY VOUCHER’ section.
raw.long_description:
Make your ethnicwear collection more colourful and varied with Koskii, a premium Indian fashion brand that celebrates the beauty of traditional craftsmanship through contemporary designs. Built on over 150 years of textile heritage, the brand offers elegant ethnic wear that blends timeless artistry with modern designs.
From intricately crafted Koskii sarees and a stunning Koskii lehenga collection to graceful salwar suits, kurta sets, gowns, and festive ensembles, the brand offers a wide selection of ethnic wear for women. Whether you're looking for a classic designer saree, a stylish saree for women for festive occasions, or elegant traditional wear for women, Koskii has thoughtfully curated collections for weddings, receptions, festive celebrations, and family gatherings. While you can have a seamless online shopping experience with the Koskii Website, with more than 30 stores across India, finding a Koskii near me is equally convenient.
A Koskii Gift Card from GyFTR lets your loved ones explore premium Indian traditional wear while enjoying additional savings.
How to buy a Koskii Gift Card?
Buying a Koskii Gift Card is simple:
Visit www.gyftr.com.
Log in using your account credentials.
Search ‘Koskii’ in the search bar.
Choose your desired denomination.
Click on the BUY NOW button and complete the transaction using the available payment modes.
You will receive your Koskii Gift Card via SMS/Email/WhatsApp.
How to redeem Koskii Gift Cards?
Koskii Gift Cards for Special Occasions
A Koskii Gift Card is a thoughtful gift for anyone who loves dressing up for life's special moments. Whether it's a birthday, wedding, anniversary, festive celebration like Diwali, Holi, Eid, Rakhi, and more, it gives recipients the freedom to choose styles that reflect their personality and occasion. From elegant Koskii sarees and beautifully embroidered designer saree collections to a stunning Koskii lehenga and festive ethnic wear, there's something for every celebration. Instead of guessing sizes or preferences, let your loved ones choose outfits they'll truly enjoy wearing.
Koskii Gift Cards for Corporate Gifting
A Koskii Gift Card is a refined and meaningful choice for workplace gifting, offering recipients the flexibility to shop for premium festive and occasion wear. Whether you're planning corporate Diwali gifts, corporate gifts for Women’s Day, exploring corporate gift ideas, or enhancing Employee Benefits, it gives employees access to elegant ethnic fashion for every celebration. As part of corporate gifts for employees or Diwali gift ideas for corporates, Koskii Gift Cards stand out by offering beautifully crafted ethnic wear and occasion-ready styles that recipients can wear for weddings, festivals, and memorable family celebrations.
